issues.title: [A] Security launch blockers (uploads, secrets, invites, hardening)
issues.body:
## Type
bug

## Intent
Schließe die bestätigten Launch-Blocker aus dem Security-Audit 2026-11-14: öffentliche Uploads, OpenSEO-SSO-Default, Invite ohne Grant-Subset, fehlende Headers/Rate-Limits, unsichere 5xx, nicht-atomare Outbox-Claims, CI-Dependency-Audit.

## Goal
Private Dateien nur authentifiziert und tenant-gebunden; Secrets fail-closed; keine Rechteeskalation über Invites; Basis-Hardening aktiv; CI prüft High/Critical Audits.

## Non-Goals
- Granularer Permission-Editor (Epic D)
- Fine-Read-Rollout aller Module (Epic C)
- Native HR
- Spekulative Abteilungs-Tabellen

## Context
- Existing: `apps/api/src/index.ts` public `/uploads/`
- Existing: `apps/api/src/lib/env.ts` OpenSEO default
- Existing: `business/routes.ts` invites ohne `assertGrantSubset`
- Reuse: `assertGrantSubset`, finance AuthZ pattern
- Links: `.qa/design/authz-hardening-epic.md`, `.qa/runs/security-checklist-full-codebase-20261114.md`

## Scope
In:
- `apps/api/src/index.ts`, media routes, env, invites, outbox, CI, docs SECURITY/OPERATIONS
- Writers that emit `/uploads/` paths
Out:
- Permission UI
- HR modules
- Full `*.read` rollout

## Security & Data
- SC-01 media AuthZ; B-07 invites; B-10 OpenSEO; B-05 helmet; B-06 rate limits; P-06 outbox; P-01 CI audit
- No secrets in logs/responses

## Edge Cases
- Path traversal in media URL
- Legacy `/uploads/` URLs with session cookie
- Invite accept after inviter lost grants
- Foreign bundleId on invite

## Acceptance
- [ ] Unauthenticated `/uploads/*` and media paths return 401/403; member of owning tenant can download; cross-tenant denied
- [ ] `OPENSEO_SSO_SHARED_SECRET` has no prod-viable Zod default; missing/placeholder fails closed
- [ ] Invite create + accept enforce grant-subset on effective bundle keys; foreign bundles rejected
- [ ] Helmet headers present; baseline API rate limit on; 5xx responses generic; outbox claim atomic; CI runs dependency audit
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches (typed-strict Boy Scout)

## Runner
Feature slug: security-launch-blockers
Priority: P0
Design: .qa/design/authz-hardening-epic.md

issues.title: [B] Authorization core: catalog, scopes, can() helper
dependsOn: [A] Security launch blockers (uploads, secrets, invites, hardening)
issues.body:
## Type
feature

## Intent
Erweitere die bestehende AuthZ-Schicht um einen zentralen `can(actor, action, resource, context)`-Pfad und dokumentierte Scope-Typen (own/assigned/project_member/company), ohne zweite Rollenengine.

## Goal
Eine serverseitige Prüf-API und Katalog-Erweiterung, auf der Modul-Routen und die spätere UI aufsetzen.

## Non-Goals
- Permission-Editor UI
- Alle Module in einem PR umstellen
- HR-Datenmodell

## Context
- Existing: `packages/shared/src/permissions.ts`, `apps/api/src/lib/authorize.ts`
- Reuse: `hasPermission`, `assertGrantSubset`, `canAccessProjectTeam`
- Links: `.qa/design/authz-hardening-epic.md`

## Scope
In:
- `packages/shared/src/permissions.ts`, `authorize.ts`, tests, SECURITY.md
Out:
- Mass route rewrites (Epic C)
- UI (Epic D)

## Security & Data
- B-08 deny-by-default; B-09 session identity only

## Edge Cases
- Unknown action → deny
- Owner vs sensitive resource exceptions documented

## Acceptance
- [ ] Typed catalog documents module.resource.action keys and which scopes apply
- [ ] `can()` helper exists and is unit-tested for deny-by-default + owner rules
- [ ] No second parallel role table introduced
- [ ] SECURITY.md updated with scope model
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches (typed-strict Boy Scout)

## Runner
Feature slug: authz-core-can-helper
Priority: P1
Design: .qa/design/authz-hardening-epic.md

issues.title: [C] Module AuthZ: replace canMutateContent with fine keys
dependsOn: [B] Authorization core: catalog, scopes, can() helper
issues.body:
## Type
feature

## Intent
Setze für implementierte Module (CRM, Inbox, Projects, Marketing, Ads, Catalog/Products, Settings reads) die Katalog-Keys durch — Reads nicht nur Membership, Writes nicht nur `canMutateContent`.

## Goal
Fachfremde Schreibrechte und Membership-only Reads sind auf den betroffenen Routen geschlossen.

## Non-Goals
- Permission UI
- Spekulative Module ohne Code

## Context
- Existing: finance routes as positive pattern
- Inventory: Phase-0 route matrix in epic design / agent transcript

## Scope
In:
- `apps/api/src/modules/{customers,inbox,projects,marketing,ads,catalog,products,settings,integrations}/`
Out:
- UI tree editor

## Security & Data
- B-08 fine keys; lists/exports respect same gates

## Edge Cases
- Project visibility still intersects with project membership
- Sensitive finance keys unchanged

## Acceptance
- [ ] Named module keys enforced on sampled GET/POST routes (CRM, Inbox, Projects, Marketing)
- [ ] `canMutateContent` removed from those module mutations (or shrunk to zero uses there)
- [ ] Negative tests: member without key → 403
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches (typed-strict Boy Scout)
- [ ] Composition-gate CLEAR for multi-hop sync/reply paths if touched

## Runner
Feature slug: authz-module-fine-keys
Priority: P1
Design: .qa/design/authz-hardening-epic.md

issues.title: [D] Permission management UI (simple + advanced)
dependsOn: [B] Authorization core: catalog, scopes, can() helper
issues.body:
## Type
feature

## Intent
Dark-Ops Team/Permissions UI: Bundles zuweisen, effektive Rechte und Herkunft zeigen, Simple- und Advanced-Modus, Schutz vor Selbstentmachtung und unzulässiger Vergabe.

## Goal
Admins können Rollen/Bundles und effektive Rechte im Produkt verwalten; UI folgt Server-AuthZ.

## Non-Goals
- Neue Design-Systeme
- HR-UI

## Context
- Existing: `SettingsTeamTab.tsx`, `BundlesEditor.tsx`
- Reuse: Dark-Ops tokens, i18n DE/EN

## Scope
In:
- `apps/web/src/features/settings/*`, shared permission display helpers
Out:
- API AuthZ engine redesign

## User Journey
1. Admin öffnet Settings → Team
2. Wählt Simple-Rolle oder Advanced-Baum
3. Speichert; Server lehnt Escalation ab

## Security & Data
- UI never sole AuthZ; B-07 enforced server-side

## Edge Cases
- Last admin self-demotion warning
- Powerful permission warnings

## Acceptance
- [ ] Simple mode assigns system/custom bundles
- [ ] Advanced mode shows module→action tree with effective rights + source
- [ ] Unauthorized grant shows clear error; AU / Dark-Ops states present
- [ ] DE/EN labels
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches (typed-strict Boy Scout)

## Runner
Feature slug: authz-permission-ui
Priority: P1
Design: .qa/design/authz-hardening-epic.md

issues.title: [F] HR integration contract (no speculative HR app)
issues.body:
## Type
docs

## Intent
HR ist nativ nicht im Repo. Erstelle einen Integrationsvertrag für eine spätere native HR-Anbindung ohne doppelte Auth und ohne spekulative APIs/UI.

## Goal
Klarer Vertrag: Identität, Tenant, benötigte Permission-Keys, Datenhoheit, Out-of-scope.

## Non-Goals
- HR-UI, HR-Tabellen, LMS/Fleet-Implementierung

## Context
- Phase-0: no HR module/routes/nav

## Scope
In:
- `docs/` contract + DECISIONS pointer
Out:
- Application code for HR

## Security & Data
- Sensitive HR keys reserved in catalog comments only if added as reserved — no empty surfaces

## Edge Cases
- External HR coordinator remains SoT until native cutover

## Acceptance
- [ ] Docs state HR is external/not native today
- [ ] Required future permission groups listed without implementing APIs
- [ ] Auth/tenant single-sign-on expectations documented
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches (typed-strict Boy Scout)
- [ ] No empty HR screens shipped

## Runner
Feature slug: hr-integration-contract
Priority: P2
Design: .qa/design/authz-hardening-epic.md
